description: This file defines classes and interfaces related to creating and managing GrainReference objects within the Orleans distributed application framework. It includes implementations for creating grain references, mapping interface types to proxy types, and providing activators for grain references with or without specific interfaces.

classes.name: GrainReferenceActivator
classes.description: Central class for creating GrainReference instances based on grain ID and interface type, managing activators for different grain types and interfaces.

classes.name: UntypedGrainReferenceActivatorProvider
classes.description: Provides grain reference activators for grains without specific interface types, creating references based on grain ID.

classes.name: RpcProvider
classes.description: Maps GrainInterfaceType to generated proxy types, facilitating the creation of proxy objects for grain interfaces.

classes.name: GrainReferenceActivatorProvider
classes.description: Provides grain reference activators that use generated proxy objects, supporting both ordered and unordered invocation options.

methods.name: CreateReference
methods.description: Creates a GrainReference for a given grain ID and interface type.

methods.name: CreateActivator
methods.description: Creates an activator for a specific grain type and interface type, with thread safety.

methods.name: TryGet
methods.description: Attempts to retrieve a proxy type for a given GrainInterfaceType.

methods.name: GetMainInterface
methods.description: Determines the main interface implemented by a type, considering interface inheritance.

methods.name: TryGet
methods.description: Attempts to get the proxy type for a specific GrainInterfaceType, considering generic arguments.

methods.name: GrainReference
methods.description: Represents a reference to a grain, created via various activators.
